% A document written for pdflatex that reaches pdfTeX's primitives that are
% an error in DVI mode through \pdfprimitive, which runs a primitive's own
% meaning whatever the name's meaning is now, and through expl3's and
% pdftexcmds' copies of it, \tex_primitive:D and \pdf@primitive. In the PDF
% each one writes into the PDF and puts nothing on the page. On the page
% the text around each one stays, and none of their arguments shows. They
% come before the class, in the preamble, in the body, in italic,
% sans-serif, and typewriter text, in a footnote, a theorem, a heading
% written to the table of contents, a macro, math, and after a document's
% own \pdfliteral. \pdfprimitive before a primitive that DVI mode allows
% stays that primitive.
\pdfoutput=1
\pdfprimitive\pdfmapline{+foo.map}
\RequirePackage{pdftexcmds}
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\pdfprimitive\pdfmapline{+bar.map}
\pdfprimitive\pdfmapfile{+first.map}
\newcommand\lit{\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g}}
\newcommand\blue[1]{\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 0 1 rg}#1\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g}}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

\section{Head \pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g}x end}

Details: before\setbox2\hbox{x}\pdfprimitive\pdfxform 2 after.

Literal: before\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after.

Italic: \textit{before\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after}.

Sans: \textsf{before\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after}.

Typewriter: \texttt{before\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after}.

Footnote: before\footnote{Note\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} six end.} after.

\begin{theorem}
Theorem \pdfprimitive\pdfsave\pdfprimitive\pdfrestore seven end.
\end{theorem}

Macro: before \blue{one} after.

Chain: before\setbox2\hbox{y}\pdfprimitive\pdfxform2
\pdfprimitive\pdfrefxform\pdfprimitive\pdflastxform{} after.

Name: [\pdfprimitive\pdfxformname\pdfprimitive\pdflastxform] end.

Csname: before\expandafter\pdfprimitive\csname pdfliteral\endcsname{0 g} after.

Mine: {\renewcommand\pdfliteral[1]{[mine #1]}\pdfliteral{x} and
before\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after}.

\makeatletter
Pdftexcmds: before\pdf@primitive\pdfliteral{0 g} after.
\makeatother

\ExplSyntaxOn
Expl:~before \tex_primitive:D \pdfliteral {0~g} ~ after.
\ExplSyntaxOff

Strcmp: [\ifnum\pdfprimitive\pdfstrcmp{a}{a}=0 same\else different\fi].

Edef: \edef\cmp{\pdfprimitive\pdfstrcmp{a}{b}}[\cmp].

Hbox: [\pdfprimitive\hbox{y}].

Math: before $a\pdfprimitive\pdfliteral{0 g}b$ after.

Macro math: before $a\lit b$ after.

Blue math: before $a\blue{b}c$ after.

Hbox math: before $a\pdfprimitive\hbox{b}c$ after.
\end{document}
